verdicts.reason: A has a strong headline and CTA, but the plan cards are tiny and their labels can't be read. The cards are also out of order (6, 80, 48), and the subtitle and legal copy are crammed into a right-hand column that runs to the bottom edge. B is broken: the orphaned word 'week' collides with the subtitle, the card panels are cut off so the cream '48 / per year' sits on a light background and almost disappears, and the headline is too small to lead the layout.
